title: Qualify Soh digestion arithmetic and register a grouped kinetic recipe
body:
Parent #770; follows source-admission #774. Produce the first bounded, independently replayed kinetic training export for Soh et al. MSV000092631 through Hitlist's existing EvidenceStore recipe API. Source admission alone is not a training label.

## Work

1. Independently replay original Skyline-to-raw, background/filter, technical and biological aggregation for every admitted substrate/condition, preserving contributor IDs and source versus derived quantities. Report unresolved synthesis-error, I/L and positional mapping decisions explicitly. Retain the RF1 0 h/1 h source conflict and exclude affected trajectories unless reconciled from original evidence.
2. Declare a response endpoint and missingness/selection policy: relative detected MS1 signal over time, never molar fragment concentration or biological absence. Keep reported zeros, forced zeros, below-background/censored values and unobserved products separate. Preserve short and nonbinding peptides; make contiguous and spliced products distinguishable and use named mapping policies.
3. Measure technical/biological temporal repeatability before admission. Group all Ffh ratios by one construct and keep overlapping fragments, modified forms and repeat acquisitions together. Freeze prospective substrate-grouped validation/test splits with the small independent-parent count visible.
4. Materialize one declared canonical recipe with every candidate's accept/exclude decision, source contribution, transformed target, source hashes and split. Independently replay every output and verify old source/recipe payloads survive byte-identically.

## Acceptance

A reviewer can reproduce the all-admitted-substrate arithmetic and each recipe row from original source bytes; all conflicts and exclusions are counted, the endpoint is scientifically scoped, format/lint/full tests and final-head CI pass, and the version-bumped PR is merged and published to PyPI. This does not close broader APC precursor/MS-response/selection requirements in #723, #757, #759 or #762.

## Presto arithmetic, admission and train-only temporal evidence (2026-10-23)

[All-substrate arithmetic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1057_codex_digestion-arithmetic/README.md), [canonical admission and independent replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1123_codex_digestion-timecourse-admission/README.md), and [training-only temporal repeatability](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/2026-10-23_1138_codex_digestion-temporal-signal/README.md) are published on the Presto draft PR.

All17 original arithmetic conditions pass (545,664 raw quantities/280,664 final slots). Source mock time-zero rows occur in CaM, IF2, UBE2S and RF1; real-baseline evidence and the RF1 time exclusion remain necessary. The recipe admits30,566 curves/125,423 positive targets, independently replayed across all50,372 disposition groups. There are only6/3/2 admitted train/validation/test parents. Reviewed source upgrades retain all numerical targets/mappings/splits; the later zero-count check adds a reason to one already-excluded curve only. Original and reviewed exports, source hashes, failed compatibility attempt and exact metadata amendment are preserved.

A separately preregistered training-only temporal-ratio diagnostic passes its descriptive gate in5/6 parents: equal-parent log10 RMSE0.67267 using the other biological label versus0.98579 for no temporal change. LEDGF worsens and remains included. All67,576 diagnostic predictions and independent scalar replay are retained. This is supplied-measurement repeatability, not a sequence model or concentration prediction. No biological kinetic fit has run.

Immutable Hitlist3e0b999 passes the unchanged normal guarded suite:3,350tests/10warnings/176.08s with two workers. This does not cover subsequent upstream edits or replace final-head release gates. Upstream review independently inspected held-out descriptive repeatability; preserve this exposure in later modeling claims. No kinetic model outcomes or split changes have been used. [Next sequence-to-rate and exact/sampled specification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/1d585b9/experiments/agents/codex/plans/biological-independent-cut-fit.md). Full APC machinery/transport/clearance/MS calibration requirements remain open.
